answer.location_description: Top-right corner of the image: roughly the top 4-5 rows across the right half (row 0, columns ~13-23), plus the rightmost column (rows 0-4) and a hot spot near row 3, columns 15-16. This is the image border, away from the centred nodule.
answer.shortcut_type: bright corner artifact/marker in top-right border region
answer.mechanism: Two groups of structured layer-1 units read the top-right corner with opposite signs. Units 7, 13, 23 and 29 have large negative biases and positive weights there, and they feed layer-2 units with positive output weights (u0, u1, u7, u8, u10, u14). Units 12, 14, 17 and 25 have large positive biases and negative weights there, and they feed layer-2 units with negative output weights (u4, u5, u11) or suppress the malignant ones (17->u10 -99, 17->u14 -74, 17->u0 -76). Brightness in the top-right corner therefore switches on the malignant pathway and switches off the benign pathway, pushing the logit positive.
answer.evidence: Row 0, columns 12-23: unit 7 has 23 21 39 18 23 38 35 27 27 33 36 33 and unit 29 has 31 11 28 41 14 25 30 26 32 37 31 42. The left half of row 0 is much weaker in both units (e.g. unit 7 columns 0-5: 5 11 17 -3 5 11). Unit 14, row 0, columns 13-23 are all negative (-43 -29 -18 -8 -39 -28 -29 -13 -37 -40 -43), while its top-left is mixed (-24 -4 15 12). At row 4, column 23: units 14, 17 and 25 have -44, -43 and -32, while units 7, 29 and 23 have 48, 32 and 19. At row 3, column 15: units 7 and 29 have 54 and 53, and unit 17 has -44. The same left-right asymmetry appears in units 12, 17 and 25: top-right weights of -27 to -41 versus near-zero at top-left. The rest of each of these units is organised as centred ring and blob templates around the nodule, so this off-centre corner selectivity is not explained by a nodule feature. The remaining 24 units look like untrained noise (|w|<~25, no structure).
answer.main_feature: Centred templates over the nodule and its margin. Units 12/14/17/25, which favour benign, weight a bright annulus around the centre positively. Units 7/13/23/29, which favour malignant, respond to irregular bright structure near the centre and to bright surroundings at the image periphery rather than a clean dark lung ring. Together these capture nodule shape and margin, i.e. smooth well-circumscribed versus irregular.
